naslov: AI Wars Ep. 14: Anthropic IPO 6x oversubscribed, Nvidia chips in China AI?
opis:
Orders for Anthropic's IPO are six times the size of the offering, putting it on track to be the largest public offering ever, with the price expected next Wednesday and buyers from China and Hong Kong turned away over US export rules. Meanwhile, former OpenAI researcher Will DePue claims forensic "fingerprints" in released weights show six Chinese models from DeepSeek, Moonshot, MiniMax and Ant Group were trained on Nvidia Blackwell systems, though his analysis doesn't show how the chips were obtained.

naslov: What is a context window? AI explained in 30 seconds
opis:
A context window is how much text an AI model can see at once: your messages, its replies and any files, measured in tokens. When it fills up, the oldest parts drop out, which is why long chats start to "forget." Example: Thinking Machines just released open weights for Inkling 2 Small, which has a context window of up to a million tokens.
